notes: Account overview: mid-size digital asset manager moving critical inference workloads into a private VPC. Strong regulatory requirements (FINRA-adjacent), strict data residency and audit obligations.

Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed encryption keys. Must support AWS KMS (CMEK + CloudHSM), Azure Key Vault (including Dedicated HSM/purge protection), and GCP KMS (CMEK/BYOK). Will evaluate BYOK import path into HSM.

Security team wants envelope encryption architecture doc + key lifecycle: creation, import, rotation cadence (90 days+), compromise procedures. Wants to own root keys in their HSM and have Redwood use envelope keys for runtime.

Compliance: require exportable audit logs to their Splunk instance (audit_logging), immutable retention for 7 years for certain datasets, and signed attestations for key usage. Ask for integration points (CloudTrail + CloudWatch for AWS; Azure Monitor; GCP Audit Logs).

HSM requirements: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 desired for on-prem vault; cloud HSM (AWS CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM) acceptable if attestation provided. They asked specifically about support for external HSM and PKCS#11 or KMIP proxies.

Network: VPC peering with customer VPC, PrivateLink endpoints, and egress restrictions. They want a single-tenant control plane in their VPC or an option for private control plane. Asked about support for VPC endpoints to KMS service and whether Redwood needs cross-account roles.
Operational: need token/credential rotation procedures and proof that Redwood never persists raw customer keys. Want KMS logs surfaced in Redwood Console per-route and per-request keys usage stats.

POC scope: 4-week POC to validate latency and key unwrap overhead with envelope encryption + CloudHSM-backed master key. POC to include sample chat workload and embeddings pipeline (100 qps peak bursts, p50 < 180ms for chat generation).
Cost sensitivity: high — will evaluate cost for dedicated HSM and egress but willing to pay for strong guarantees. Expect detailed unit economics (per-token overhead from encryption + HSM calls).
Timeline: security review kickoff 2024-07-23 (FF recorded). Legal drafting BYOK addendum ongoing. Procurement self-service for infra sign-off targeted by 2024-09.
